reviews.title: Great mouse! Light and well built
reviews.comment:
Mouse was as expected. Came in a small box and had a the charger, mouse, usb dongle, grip stickers to put on the mouse and an extra weight puck. Is very light and had no problems setting it up the drivers and changing the dpi. There are no RGB lights on it if you're looking for one that has some but is well built and works straight out of the box.
The charger is mini-usb which is known for disconnecting or falling off but there is an extra attachment for the usb that sticks it in place so that doesn't happen. Battery lasts a long time and charges up fast. Mouse is kind of expensive but if youre looking for a light mouse this is a worthwhile investment. Its only for right handed people however as the thumb buttons are on the left side.
reviews.author: David Chen

reviews.title: Best gaming mouse, better then viper
reviews.comment: This mouse is probably the best wireless mouse out there. Its on the bit more expensive side but for a good reason. It has great battery life, feel, and is super light. I had 2 vipers for a while and while they are better bang for your buck and better ergonomics, they were always very weird for me always stuttering, freezing, etc, no matter what pc I used or software I installed. Logitech though Ive had no issues and have been enjoying them with no issue.
